title: Whole Inflated-petiole Floating Rosette
description: One original complete stylised water-hyacinth-like floating rosette study: a small crown joins four unequal distinctly inflated curved leaf stalks, four entire broad oval unnotched cupped blades, and five downward tapering whole roots. The roots are exposed for a static detached specimen presentation, with one finite display sole, not a planter or floating-water simulation. Not the old waterlily rectangular rhizome with slender stalks and deeply notched horizontal pads. Zero scenes. No exact botanical identity, growth, care, cultivation, ecology, buoyancy or physical function claim.
